title: board review with a short card id gives the real refusal
notes: Retro 2026-11-28: 'board review 6ad9d4f4' answered 'has no worktree to review; ship it first', while the full id gave the real reason, 'has no pull request … yet'. A short id should be resolved to the card before the refusal is chosen, for review and any other verb that decides on the card's state. Also seen: 'board move <id> Review' exited 1 although the move was written; check and fix if it still happens.

comments.body: Same bug class: 'board ship 314ecc8a --after 3a1ee233' answered 'no card 3a1ee233 on the board to wait on'; the full id worked. --after should take a short id like every other id argument.
Pull request #429 opened: A short card id is made whole by the app's card actions, --after included https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/429

Review loop: converged, ready to merge. 1 round (floor-addressed). 4 low/nit threads fixed in bd6c7b05 01de2d39 56638cc8 48c38b8a, all accepted by the final check. pane start --after now takes a short id too, stale whole-id texts fixed, tests tightened and review.test.ts added. No conflicts. CI passed on the head commit.
